events.name: Arizona Cardinals at St. Louis Rams

headlines.description: Chandler Catanzaro kicked four field goals and the Arizona Cardinals overcame the loss of quarterback Drew Stanton with stifling defense, moving closer to clinching a playoff spot with a 12-6 victory over the St. Louis Rams on Thursday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cards down Rams on FGs but lose Stanton

headlines.description: ATLANTA -- Ben Roethlisberger threw for 360 yards, William Gay returned an interception for a touchdown, and the Pittsburgh Steelers defeated the Atlanta Falcons 27-20 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Steelers top Falcons, keep pace in AFC North

events.name: Green Bay Packers at Buffalo Bills

headlines.description: Bacarri Rambo intercepted two Aaron Rodgers passes and Marcus Thigpen scored on a 75-yard punt return, leading the Buffalo Bills to a stunning 21-13 upset over the Green Bay Packers on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bills stifle Rodgers, hold on to upset Packers

headlines.description: Johnny Manziel spent his first NFL start being chased and taunted by Cincinnati defenders as the Bengals rudely welcomed the hyped rookie quarterback to the league with a 30-0 demolition of the Cleveland Browns on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bengals rough up Manziel, Browns in rout

headlines.description: Andrew Luck threw two touchdown passes and the Colts won their second straight AFC South title by holding off the Houston Texans 17-10 Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Colts hold on to beat Texans, clinch AFC South

events.name: Oakland Raiders at Kansas City Chiefs
Miami Dolphins at New England Patriots

headlines.description: The New England Patriots clinched the AFC East title for the sixth straight season as Tom Brady threw two touchdown passes in a big third quarter that carried them to a 41-13 win over the Miami Dolphins on Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Patriots clinch AFC East with rout of Dolphins

events.name: Washington Redskins at New York Giants

headlines.description: Manning hits Beckham on 3 TD passes as Giants win
headlines.shortLinkText: Manning hits Beckham on 3 TD passes as Giants win

events.name: Tampa Bay Buccaneers at Carolina Panthers

headlines.description: Derek Anderson threw for 277 yards and a touchdown, Graham Gano kicked four field goals and the Carolina Panthers defeated the Tampa Bay Buccaneers 19-17 on Sunday to remain alive in the NFC South playoff race.
headlines.shortLinkText: Panthers top Bucs, stay in NFC South hunt

headlines.description: Ravens use defense to beat Jaguars 20-12
headlines.shortLinkText: Ravens use defense to beat Jaguars 20-12

events.name: New York Jets at Tennessee Titans

headlines.description: Chris Ivory scored on a 1-yard touchdown run with 3:09 left, and the New York Jets beat the Tennessee Titans 16-11 Sunday in a game marked by a brawl between teams playing only for pride.
headlines.shortLinkText: Jets hang on to beat Titans for 1st road win

events.name: Denver Broncos at San Diego Chargers

headlines.description: Peyton Manning played through a thigh injury and flu-like symptoms, and Connor Barth kicked five field goals to lead Denver to a 22-10 victory over the San Diego Chargers on Sunday. The win gave the Broncos their fourth straight AFC West title.
headlines.shortLinkText: Sick, sore Peyton leads Broncos to West title

headlines.description: Lions sweat out 16-14 win over Vikings
headlines.shortLinkText: Lions sweat out 16-14 win over Vikings

headlines.description: Marshawn Lynch rushed for 91 yards and a touchdown, Russell Wilson threw a touchdown to rookie Paul Richardson, and the Seattle Seahawks ended San Francisco's playoff hopes with a 17-7 win Sunday.
headlines.shortLinkText: Seahawks knock Niners out of playoffs

headlines.description: Dez Bryant caught a career-best three touchdown catches from Tony Romo and the Dallas Cowboys rallied to beat the Philadelphia Eagles 38-27 on Sunday night after wasting a 21-0 lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Cowboys rally by Eagles after losing 21-0 lead

events.name: New Orleans Saints at Chicago Bears

headlines.description: Drew Brees threw for 375 yards and three touchdowns, and the New Orleans Saints beat the Chicago Bears 31-15 on Monday night to grab the NFC South lead.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brees, Saints lash Bears for NFC South lead
